action.message: To book the marketing accrual for May, I need: 1) which entity, CA01 (Northwind Canada, CAD) or US01 (Northwind US, USD); 2) the accrual amount; 3) the offsetting balance-sheet account (for example 2100 Accrued Liabilities) and confirmation that the expense goes to 6400 Marketing and Advertising, unless you want a different account; and 4) confirmation that the department is MKT Marketing.
